title: Fabric Bronze Mapping
description:
Stage 3 of the Fabric track. Landing only.

Bronze exists to make ingestion replayable, so the single rule is: do not transform. No deduplication, no filtering, no type coercion beyond what is needed to read the file at all. Every defect declared in 02-sources survives into bronze intact -- if bronze silently fixed anything, a silver bug would be indistinguishable from an upstream change, and a replay would not reproduce the original state.

AUTHORITATIVE -- a non-conforming spec fails the build.

write_mode.description:
Bronze is immutable. `overwrite` would destroy the replayable history that is the entire reason this layer exists, so the contract permits only append.

Append makes an incremental watermark mandatory: without one, every re-run re-appends the whole source, and downstream deduplication HIDES it -- counts stay plausible while bronze quietly stops being a faithful record of what arrived.

partition_by.description: Partitioning by ingest date turns 'replay everything since Tuesday' into a partition filter rather than a full scan.

schema_evolution.description: additive_only: a new upstream column is added, never dropped.

on_schema_drift.description: A type change should stop the load. Continuing past it writes silently wrong data that looks fine until someone queries it.

target.description: Carries the source system so provenance is readable without opening lineage.

source_entity.description: source.entity, and must be registered in 02-sources.

initial_value.description: Used on the first run, when there is no high-water mark yet.

columns.description: Only `passthrough` is permitted. Selecting a subset at bronze would silently drop upstream data that can never be recovered without a re-extract -- exclusions belong in silver, where the loss is reversible.

excluded_columns.description: Declared even when empty, to satisfy the exhaustive-mapping convention: a column is either taken or explicitly refused, never overlooked.

then.description: Incremental without a watermark re-appends the whole source on every run.

landing_checks.description: The only checks bronze runs. They test whether the file ARRIVED correctly, not whether its contents are any good -- that is silver's job.
